en-us.longDescription: HDCleaner is a utility used to clean potentially unwanted files and invalid Windows Registry entries and speeds up the computer in no time. Optimized for Solid-state drives (SSD) and hard disk drives (HDD). Supports winapp2.ini. Secure deletion of files, hard drives and SSDs.
